title: Polling and Interrupt Handling
lead: Covers lecture 04 and exercise 3: doing two tasks at once, polling (system 5) and its problems, interrupts, the interrupt vector table, ISR, sei/cli, external interrupts INT0/INT1 (system 6), switch debouncing with a capacitor, pin change interrupts (system 7), Arduino attachInterrupt, and the click-counter exercise. Built from slides and peer notes pages 28 to 33.
